item.title: Helicopter crash kills four in Quebec
item.description: Four people have been killed in a helicopter crash southeast of Montreal, police said on Saturday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Four people have been killed in a helicopter crash southeast of Montreal, police said on Saturday afternoon. National broadcasters CBC and CTV reported that police said the crash happened at about 2:30 p.m. ET (1830 GMT) and that the aircraft was on fire when first responders arrived at the site near Sainte-Brigide-d'Iberville. All four occupants of the aircraft were reported dead by the Surete du Quebec, the provincial police force. Police did not immediately provide details about the helicopter's ownership, origin or its purpose for the journey. Canada's Transportation Safety Board is deploying investigators.

item.title: Gordon's goal continues debate over England's footballing identity
item.description: England winger Anthony Gordon's exhilarating counter-attacking goal against Spain on Saturday may have provided strong evidence for his argument that the home side should embrace their own strengths rather than try to imitate the world champions.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: England winger Anthony Gordon's exhilarating counter-attacking goal against Spain on Saturday may have provided strong evidence for his argument that the home side should embrace their own strengths rather than try to imitate the world champions. Days after saying England's DNA is built on direct and fast, aggressive football rather than the possession-heavy approach associated with Spain, Gordon embodied that philosophy with a superb 36th-minute goal in their 3-2 [USN:L1N45I06S TEXT:"Nations League defeat"]. England won the ball deep inside their own half and, within seconds, Jude Bellingham had surged forward and released Gordon, who sprinted clear and finished coolly past keeper Unai Simon. "Kind of, if you want to phrase it that way," Gordon said when asked whether the goal reflected his vision for England. "I've been direct, playing to the English style, being quick, really putting teams on the back foot. "(The goal) summed up what I said earlier this week which was quite nice, but it didn't lead to victory." Gordon's strike sparked a four-minute burst that also produced Harry Kane's go-ahead goal, turning a 1-0 deficit into a 2-1 lead at Wembley. Spain eventually recovered to win but Gordon left convinced England had shown they can compete with the top teams. "We just lost to the best in the world. The gap is not big in my mind and I think tonight proved that," he said. "When it went to 3-2 you see their ability to really control possession. I think against someone like that you have really got to go for the throat." Playing in La Liga at Barcelona alongside and against some of Spain's finest, Gordon said he sees first-hand how different the Spanish approach is and that England should focus on their own strengths rather than trying to copy the world champions. England boss Thomas Tuchel -- who also acknowledged earlier this week that the possession-style football of nations like Spain, Argentina and Brazil is not in England's DNA -- applauded Gordon's goal as an example of the attacking threat his side can carry when they play with conviction. "Anthony Gordon's goal was a top transition goal," Tuchel said. "We scored amazing goals and could have created more if we were more clinical in the last 20 metres. We had an incredible amount of ball wins and the effort, bravery and courage was outstanding." Ultimately, England's defeat came not from a lack of attacking ambition but from costly mistakes at the back. Yet Gordon's performance ensures the debate over England's identity continues, with the winger adamant the route to major tournament success lies not in replicating Spain but in embracing the speed, intensity and chaos that have long been hallmarks of the English game.

item.title: Fever lose Tyasha Harris to season-ending broken fibula
item.description: The Indiana Fever will be without Tyasha Harris for the remainder of the season after the team announced Saturday that the backup guard suffered a season-ending broken left fibula in the regular-season finale.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Indiana Fever will be without Tyasha Harris for the remainder of the season after the team announced Saturday that the backup guard suffered a season-ending broken left fibula in the regular-season finale. Harris was injured in the third quarter of Thursday's 86-66 loss to the Minnesota Lynx when she collapsed to the floor following a layup attempt. She had to be carried to the locker room. Harris, 28, averaged 4.1 points and 2.0 assists in 39 regular-season games (four starts) and has appeared in 211 games (53 starts) through seven WNBA seasons. She entered the league as a first-round pick by the Dallas Wings in 2020 and played for Connecticut from 2023-24 before returning to Dallas last season. Harris underwent season-ending knee injury on June 10, 2025, limiting her to only five games. She signed with Indiana in April. In Harris' absence, Raven Johnson is expected to see increased minutes off the bench behind All-Star guards Caitlin Clark and Kelsey Mitchell. The news was better for Aliyah Boston, who also left the game with a leg injury. Fever coach Stephanie White said after the game that it was a "flare-up" of an injury to Boston's right leg. Indiana begins its best-of-three first-round series against the Aces in Las Vegas on Sunday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Rangers place Josh Jung on IL; recall Robby Ahlstrom, Logan O'Hoppe
item.description: The Texas Rangers placed third baseman Josh Jung on the 10-day injured list Saturday with a right hand fracture.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Texas Rangers placed third baseman Josh Jung on the 10-day injured list Saturday with a right hand fracture. Jung, 28, was hit by a pitch from Twins starter Joe Ryan in the first inning of Friday's 10-2 loss. Jung remained in the game and scored, but exited for a pinch-hitter in his next turn at the plate. Jung finished the regular season batting .299 with 12 home runs and 42 RBIs, establishing career bests with 27 doubles and 35 walks. He was on the injured list from July 22 to Sept. 11 with a left calf strain. In 12 games after returning to the lineup, he batted .341 with three home runs and seven RBIs. "That's pretty significant," Schumaker said after Friday's game. "Him and Joc (Pederson) both with hand fractures or wrist fractures, it's not ideal at this time of the year. But we've still gotta go. We have two games left, and we've gotta figure this thing out." In other moves, the Rangers recalled left-handed pitcher Robby Ahlstrom and catcher/designated hitter Logan O'Hoppe from Triple-A Round Rock and optioned right-handed pitcher Gavin Collyer to the Arizona Complex League. This will be the third big league stint for Ahlstrom, 27, this season. He has a 3-1 record with a 6.08 ERA in 42 relief appearances. O'Hoppe, 26, batted .353 in 10 games (six starts) at DH during his first stint with the club. He was acquired via trade from the Los Angeles Angels at the trade deadline. Collyer, 25, allowed two runs in two relief innings Friday. He is 1-1 with a 5.40 ERA and 23 strikeouts over 24 relief appearances in four stints with the Rangers this season. Entering Saturday's action, the Rangers were tied with the Houston Astros for the American League West lead and battling for a postseason berth with two games left in the regular season. The Astros hold the tiebreaker over the Rangers with a 9-4 record in head-to-head games this season. --Field Level Media

item.title: Commentary: Zuckerberg’s ‘Tamagotchi-like’ AI could be Meta’s iPod moment
item.description: For someone mocked as a robotic, out-of-touch nerd, Mark Zuckerberg has struck the right tone with the Muse assistant, says Dave Lee for Bloomberg Opinion.
item.dc:creator: Dave Lee
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Commentary: Zuckerberg’s ‘Tamagotchi-like’ AI could be Meta’s iPod moment

For someone mocked as a robotic, out-of-touch nerd, Mark Zuckerberg has struck the right tone with the Muse assistant, says Dave Lee for Bloomberg Opinion.

Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg presents the Muse Charm during the Meta Connect event at the company's headquarters in Menlo Park, California, Sep 23, 2026. REUTERS/Carlos Barria

Dave Lee

Dave Lee

NEW YORK: Mark Zuckerberg is on to something. Hot on the heels of Meta’s hugely well-received launch of its Muse personal AI agent, Zuckerberg announced on Wednesday evening (Sep 23) the next phase: a “Tamagotchi-like” pendant for interacting with the cuddly assistant on the go. It’s slated to be out in time for Christmas. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman described some of Muse Charm’s features: A virtual Muse character appears at the centre of the screen, and users can customise its appearance, outfits, voice and other attributes. The device can be worn with a wrist strap, carried in a pocket or attached to a bag or keychain with a lanyard. A translucent case allows users to see the internal circuitry through the back and sides. And then, what I predict will be a masterstroke: Two users with Muse Charms can also allow their devices to recognise and interact with each other when they’re placed nearby.

How cute! For a man who in the past has been mocked for coming across as a robotic, out-of-touch nerd, Zuckerberg has struck a tone with the Muse assistant that has already set his company’s effort apart from his competitors – and prompted, I suspect, some hasty strategic rethinking.

Meta’s Muse Charm offers real-time voice and avatar interaction in a small standalone device that does not require a phone. (Photo: Meta)

STYLISH AND INNOVATIVE RECASTING Perhaps Meta’s secret is Alexandr Wang. The most-talked-about hire in Silicon Valley last year, Wang leads Meta’s artificial-intelligence efforts (and, I predict, will one day lead the whole company). On Wednesday, on stage at Meta’s developer conference, Wang described Meta’s achievement perfectly when he said: “It was only about six months ago that having a personal agent running on your own computer was the sign of someone who was completely AI-pilled.” Today, by refining the technology and adding some consumer-friendly touches, Muse is to AI agents what the iPod was to MP3 players: A stylish and innovative recasting of an existing technology so it struck a chord with everyday people. The rewards for reaching the non-nerds could be enormous. The energetic arrival of the iPod marked the rebirth of Apple as a company. Muse – whether it’s accessed through smartphone, glasses or the Charm – has the potential to do something similar for Meta. But there are challenges. Muse’s head start will be brief. OpenAI engineers are scrambling to come up with their answer. Siri AI is finally rolling out to the iPhone and seems pretty great. Zuckerberg might get a taste of his own medicine as companies with bigger AI products simply look at what he’s done with Muse and copy the best bits. There’s also what we might consider Meta’s “trust ceiling” – the upper limit of users prepared to give Meta the kind of access that any useful AI agent needs. Meta is asking customers to trust it more than ever before. Some will just say no. The question is how many. A Gallup poll conducted in June suggests consumer trust in big tech companies is low and sliding. The most recent Harris Poll 100 has Meta’s reputation among US adults trailing almost all of its peers, ranked 96th, compared with Anthropic at 16th, Apple at 20th and Alphabet at 22nd. And yet, 3.6 billion people use a Meta app every day, and the company’s playful pitch for Muse is clearly hitting differently than the doom and gloom emanating from some other AI companies. They talk about AI putting us out of jobs and maybe wiping us off the face of the Earth. Muse is instead channelling the sentiment expressed by author Joanna Maciejewska, who wrote in 2024: “I want AI to do my laundry and dishes so that I can do art and writing, not for AI to do my art and writing so that I can do my laundry and dishes.”

Related:

Commentary: How would AI kill all humans? Here are the top 5 scenarios

Commentary: AI armageddon looks different from China

A LUCRATIVE OPPORTUNITY Muse can’t do the dishes yet. But its usefulness for routine tasks is growing by the day – each one of them presenting lucrative opportunities for Meta to make serious money. What made the iPod so transformational for Apple wasn’t just the device but the fresh business model it enabled with iTunes, a centralised and locked-in digital music store from which Apple took a hard-negotiated cut of sales. That was, of course, the precursor to the App Store, which expanded that concept to digital goods of all kinds, turning Apple into the richest company in the world. Meta is well positioned to run something like that playbook again, albeit in a more crowded market. “Over time we will profit by taking a small fee from transactions” made through Muse, Zuckerberg explained in his pitch to developers on Wednesday. Behind him, a slide stated, in giant letters, “Muse makes you money.” For the first time in Meta’s 22-year history, the company has a new business model in its sights – AI subscriptions, hardware sales, cuts of AI transactions – that could eclipse the current one.  Today, advertising accounts for 98 per cent of Meta’s revenue. I wonder how that might look in two years if Muse does indeed cement itself as the first breakthrough consumer AI agent.

Source: Bloomberg/el

item.title: Reds' starter Rhett Lowder baffles Blue Jays to even series
item.description: Rhett Lowder pitched six scoreless innings Saturday afternoon and the visiting Cincinnati Reds defeated the Toronto Blue Jays 5-1.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Rhett Lowder pitched six scoreless innings Saturday afternoon and the visiting Cincinnati Reds defeated the Toronto Blue Jays 5-1. Lowder (7-12) allowed three hits and two walks with two strikeouts to finish the season with a 5.74 ERA. JJ Bleday hit a solo home run for the Reds (75-86), who gained a split of the first two games of the season-ending three-game series with the Blue Jays (78-83). Hector Rodriguez added a two-run triple and went 2-for-4. Lowder worked around two walks to open the home first with the help of a double play and was on cruise control for the rest of his outing. Cincinnati took a 1-0 lead against Trey Yesavage (5-6) when Bleday led off the second by pounding a 1-0 fastball to right center for his career-best 24th homer of the season. Yesavage, who was making his second start after arthroscopic knee surgery, allowed one run, two hits and one walk with three strikeouts in two innings. The Reds added two runs against Spencer Miles in the third. Matt McLain walked and Carlos Jorge beat out a bunt single down the first-base line. After a double steal, McLain scored when Andres Gimenez fumbled Sal Stewart's grounder to shortstop. Eugenio Suarez followed by cracking an RBI double to left. Cincinnati scored twice in the fifth against John Klein. Bleday walked with two out and took second when Sean Keys was charged with an error for misplaying Tyler Stephenson's cue shot along the first-base line. Both runners scored on a triple to left by Rodriguez over the head of Josh Smith, who backed into the wall and then had to chase the ball. Lowder, meanwhile, had no trouble with the Blue Jays before Connor Phillips replaced him in the seventh and allowed one run. Kazuma Okamoto led off with a walk, took third on Smith's double and scampered home on Gimenez's groundout to second. Toronto got four solid relief innings from Klein, who allowed two unearned runs and fanned five Reds. Cincinnati's Graham Ashcraft pitched around a single in the eighth and Tejay Antone took care of the ninth for the Reds. --Field Level Media

item.title: Colorado WR DeAndre Moore injured on hit, leaves game
item.description: The Colorado Buffaloes lost wide receiver DeAndre Moore late in the second quarter after a hard hit during Saturday's game at Baylor.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Colorado Buffaloes lost wide receiver DeAndre Moore late in the second quarter after a hard hit during Saturday's game at Baylor. With the Bears leading 10-3 and less than five minutes to play before halftime, Moore, Colorado's leading receiver coming into the day, went across the middle and reached down for a low pass from quarterback Julian Lewis. Baylor linebacker Travion Barnes also went low and hit Moore near the head and shoulders as the ball arrived to break up the play with 4:33 left. Moore was down for several minutes before getting up. He walked off the field with help and went straight to the locker room. He did not return for the start of the second half. Buffaloes coach Deion Sanders said afterward that Moore was doing good. Sanders believes Moore sustained a head injury. "He's a warrior," Sanders said. "He was down like ‘you're not bringing out a cart, you're not bringing out a cart. I'm getting up and walking off.' I admire that from him so much." The senior entered Saturday with 15 receptions for 200 yards and a touchdown. He spent the prior two seasons with Texas, grabbing 77 balls for 988 yards and 11 scores in Austin. He did not have a catch Saturday before exiting. --Field Level Media

item.title: Volley-Les Bleus battus en finale de l'Euro par la Pologne
item.description: L'équipe de France masculine de volley s'est inclinée contre la Pologne (31-29, 25-19, 20-25, 25-16) samedi en finale de l'Euro mais retrouve tout de même le podium continental, 11 ans après son sacre.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'équipe de France masculine de volley s'est inclinée contre la Pologne (31-29, 25-19, 20-25, 25-16) samedi en finale de l'Euro mais retrouve tout de même le podium continental, 11 ans après son sacre. Dans un remake de la finale des Jeux olympiques de Paris 2024, les Polonais ont pris leur revanche à Milan (Italie) pour ravir un troisième titre européen, le deuxième consécutif. La première manche, particulièrement accrochée, a fini dans l'escarcelle de la Pologne malgré quatre balles de set en faveur des doubles champions olympiques en titre. Les joueurs d'Andrea Giani pensaient même avoir empoché ce set initial mais un challenge vidéo a inversé le point décisif, avant que les Polonais ne concluent. Peut-être abattus par cette issue cruelle, les Français ont très mal entamé la manche suivante et n'ont jamais pu refaire leur retard. Menés deux manches à rien, ils avaient alors besoin d'un miracle. Le troisième set a laissé croire que celui-ci était possible puisque les coéquipiers de Moussé Guèye, précieux en sortie de banc, ont réduit l'écart. Sauf que la Pologne a repris le dessus et fait la course en tête dans la manche suivante pour finalement s'imposer en quatre sets sur sa troisième opportunité. La France conclut cependant avec une médaille d'argent une compétition qu'elle n'abordait pas parmi les équipes favorites, un an après son élimination au tour préliminaire du Mondial. Cette jeune escouade, privée de la majorité des champions olympiques de 2024, avait difficilement débuté son été en terminant 10e de la Ligue des nations.

item.title: Gonzalo weakens into post-tropical cyclone, NHC says
item.description: Gonzalo has weakened into a post-tropical cyclone and is no longer considered a tropical cyclone, the U.S. National Hurricane Center said on Saturday, issuing its final advisory on the system.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Gonzalo has weakened into a post-tropical cyclone and is no longer considered a tropical cyclone, the U.S. National Hurricane Center said on Saturday, issuing its final advisory on the system. The post-tropical cyclone was located about 180 miles north of Sal in Cabo Verde and had maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (65 km/h), the Miami-based forecaster said. "Additional weakening is forecast, and the post-tropical cyclone is expected to dissipate over eastern Subtropical Atlantic by the early to mid portion of next week," the NHC added.

item.title: Jefes de Asuntos Exteriores de Rusia y Alemania mantienen en la ONU primeras conversaciones desde 2022
item.description: Los ministros de Asuntos Exteriores de Rusia y Alemania se reunieron el sábado en Nueva York, al margen de la Asamblea General de la ONU, en lo que supuso la primera ronda de conversaciones de este tipo desde antes de la invasión rusa de Ucrania en 2022.
item.dc:creator: Antoni Slodkowski, Tom Balmforth
item.content:encoded: Los ministros de Asuntos Exteriores de Rusia y Alemania se reunieron el sábado en Nueva York, al margen de la Asamblea General de la ONU, en lo que supuso la primera ronda de conversaciones de este tipo desde antes de la invasión rusa de Ucrania en 2022. Las relaciones entre Moscú y Berlín, aliado cercano de Ucrania, se han enfriado desde la invasión rusa, y las tensiones se agudizaron aún más tras un incidente con un dron en el aeropuerto de Leipzig/Halle, en el este de Alemania, el pasado mes de agosto. Como muestra de la persistente frialdad en las relaciones, el ministro de Asuntos Exteriores ruso, Serguéi Lavrov, declaró en una rueda de prensa que no había obtenido de su homólogo alemán, durante las conversaciones, ninguna información nueva que Berlín no hubiera ya hecho pública en sus comunicados oficiales. "Le dije que, francamente... podría simplemente haberme llamado y haberme dicho: 'lee mi comunicado'", afirmó Lavrov. Aun así, los ministros abordaron las relaciones bilaterales y la guerra en Ucrania, según informaron fuentes oficiales de ambas partes. El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores alemán, Johann Wadephul, aprovechó las conversaciones para instar a Lavrov a hacer "todo lo posible por alcanzar un acuerdo sobre las exportaciones de cereales a través del mar Negro", según una fuente de la delegación alemana. La reunión se produce en medio de los esfuerzos diplomáticos por reactivar las exportaciones de cereales y energía de Rusia y Ucrania a través del mar Negro, que se han visto drásticamente reducidas por los ataques a buques y a la infraestructura portuaria. Lavrov declaró en la rueda de prensa que Rusia había mantenido conversaciones con la India, Egipto y Turquía sobre propuestas para garantizar la navegación segura en el mar Negro, lo que podría implicar acuerdos bilaterales entre Rusia y esos países. "Es necesario mantener conversaciones por separado con los ucranianos, y no en tono de petición, sino más bien de exigencia", afirmó, culpando a Ucrania de los ataques a los buques. Ucrania ha declarado que está abierta a acuerdos y achaca todas las consecuencias de la guerra a Rusia y a su invasión. Wadephul le dijo a Lavrov: "El tiempo es esencial: dada la escasez de alimentos en muchos países —especialmente en el Sur Global—, todas las partes deben estar dispuestas a participar de forma constructiva", según la fuente de la delegación alemana. El ministro alemán también señaló a Lavrov que "una solución pragmática podría allanar el camino para nuevos pasos concretos", añadió la fuente. RELACIONES BILATERALES Como muestra de la delicadeza que entraña reunirse con el ministro de Asuntos Exteriores ruso en tiempos de guerra, Wadephul informó posteriormente a sus aliados europeos de la reunión en un mensaje al que ha tenido acceso Reuters. "Aproveché esta oportunidad para reiterar nuestra posición sobre la guerra de agresión de Rusia contra Ucrania y para pedir un alto el fuego inmediato y completo, centrándome de manera urgente en las exportaciones de cereales y en la infraestructura energética", escribió. El Gobierno alemán afirmó este mes que había llegado a la conclusión de que Rusia era responsable de ese intento de ataque con drones. Como represalia, cerró un consulado y un centro cultural ruso en Berlín. La embajada rusa en Berlín ha desestimado las acusaciones calificándolas de "provocación inventada" y de "una nueva ola de histeria antirrusa en Alemania". Wadephul aprovechó las conversaciones para instar a Rusia a "abandonar la peligrosa vía de la escalada frente a Alemania, Europa y la OTAN", según la fuente de la delegación. Wadephul afirmó que incidentes como el intento de ataque en Leipzig o nuevos ataques híbridos no harían tambalear la determinación de Alemania de apoyar a Ucrania, según fuentes de la delegación.

item.title: World champions Spain punish England errors to win Nations League thriller
item.description: Spain's Mikel Oyarzabal scored the winner as the world champions capitalised on two calamitous England defensive errors to claim a thrilling 3-2 victory at Wembley on Saturday, in the standout fixture of the opening round of the Nations League.
item.dc:creator: Lori Ewing
item.content:encoded: Spain's Mikel Oyarzabal scored the winner as the world champions capitalised on two calamitous England defensive errors to claim a thrilling 3-2 victory at Wembley on Saturday, in the standout fixture of the opening round of the Nations League. Less than 10 weeks after lifting the World Cup, Spain, unbeaten in 39 games, made England pay in scoring their first two goals. Teen sensation Lamine Yamal struck in the second minute when Marc Guehi was caught in possession deep inside his own half. Alex Baena scored on the hour after Nico O'Reilly's misplaced pass handed possession back to the visitors. Oyarzabal, who also got the winner against England in the 2024 European Championship final, struck the decider in the 74th minute with a clever dink over goalkeeper James Trafford. "There are many matches within a match and we've known how to play them all at every moment," Spain coach Luis de la Fuente said. "England has a lot of talent to hurt at any moment, but we've controlled the game." Spain's victory spoiled what had briefly looked like being a memorable England comeback -- and a small measure of redemption after their heartbreaking World Cup semi-final loss to Argentina. England had turned the game on its head in a thrilling four-minute span, with Anthony Gordon's 36th-minute equaliser sparking a blistering spell that culminated in captain Harry Kane heading the hosts in front. "We're playing against the world champions, the European champions, and we went toe-to-toe," Kane told ITV. "On another day for sure we'd have won that game." Kane was left shaking his head though after firing a second-half penalty off the inside of the crossbar when his left foot slipped upon planting. "Terrible start, the worst start possible," England manager Thomas Tuchel said. "Makes it so, so difficult to be behind against this kind of team. The reaction was very good, very good. "The third goal was the only one they really scored -- the others were from individual, big mistakes." England and Spain had arrived at Wembley with very different World Cup memories. The Spaniards looked to build on their triumph, while Tuchel's men were still feeling the scars of defeat and aiming to show they could narrow the gap. EVERGREEN MODRIC LEADS BY EXAMPLE In Saturday's other Group A3 game, Croatia gave new manager Slaven Bilic a 2-1 victory over the Czech Republic as evergreen captain Luka Modric once again proved influential before Marco Pasalic struck the decisive goal. The 41-year-old Modric, still the heartbeat of the Croatia side more than two decades after his international debut, put the visitors ahead two minutes after the break. The Czechs responded through Adam Karabec in the 54th minute but Pasalic restored Croatia's advantage with 13 minutes remaining to secure all three points. The game marked a new start for both sides. Bilic is back in charge of Croatia after Zlatko Dalic's departure following their round-of-32 World Cup defeat by Portugal, while Spaniard Santi Denia was appointed the Czechs' boss after their group-stage exit. Scotland began life under Sebastien Pocognoli with a 0-0 draw away to Slovenia in Group B1, offering glimpses of the more attacking style the Belgian hopes to implement following manager Steve Clarke's departure after Scotland's World Cup exit. Oli McBurnie, back in the Scotland fold after a five-year absence, had some of the best chances but a string of brilliant saves from Jan Oblak had the Scots settling for a point. Switzerland made an impressive start to their first League B campaign, with Remo Freuler opening the scoring and Zeki Amdouni netting the first of his two goals before halftime en route to a 3-0 win away to North Macedonia. Finland's Joel Pohjanpalo scored a hat-trick to help his country to a 7-0 thrashing of San Marino in Group C1.

item.title: Tigers walk off Pirates to win Justin Verlander’s farewell start
item.description: Eduardo Valencia hit a two-out, two-strike, two-run home run in the ninth inning to lift the host Detroit Tigers to a 4-3 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates Saturday in Justin Verlander's final start.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Eduardo Valencia hit a two-out, two-strike, two-run home run in the ninth inning to lift the host Detroit Tigers to a 4-3 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates Saturday in Justin Verlander's final start. The Tigers were down 3-1 in the ninth with Verlander on the hook for the loss. Facing Pirates closer Mason Montgomery (6-4), Max Clark singled with one out and Hao-Yu Lee doubled him to third. Kevin McGonigle brought Lee in with a groundout to make it 3-2. Valencia ended it with a homer just over the fence in left. Jacob Waguespack (2-2) picked up the win in relief. Verlander gave up five hits and two runs in 5 1/3 innings. The right-hander walked one and struck out six in 91 pitches. It was the 43-year-old's first start since March 30 and just his second start in his second stint with the Tigers. A hip injury landed him on the injured list, and hamstring issues kept him out for months. He announced he was retiring during the season and the Tigers (76-85) decided to give him his last start at home on the next-to-last day of the season. He did not make a minor league rehab start, instead building up through live batting practice, a simulated inning and bullpen sessions. He said he would have been happy with 20 pitches. Instead, in his 557th career start, Verlander allowed only two runs, both on solo homers, and pitched into the sixth inning. After Brandon Lowe fouled out to the catcher to start the sixth, Detroit manager AJ Hinch left the dugout and detoured toward the stands to bring Genevieve, Verlander's seven-year-old daughter, onto the field to sprint to the mound and take her dad out of the game. Verlander pitched for the Tigers from 2005-2017. It was his first start in Detroit in a Tigers uniform since August 20, 2017. He finished his career 266-159. The Pirates (81-80) need to win Sunday to finish over .500 for the first time since 2018 and avoid the sweep. Lowe gave the Pirates the early lead with a home run to lead off the second. Jacob Gonzalez made it 2-0 with a two-out shot deep into the right field stands. Javier Baez doubled home Spencer Torkelson in the sixth to pull Detroit within 2-1, but Bryan Reynolds restored Pittsburgh's two-run lead with an RBI triple in the eighth. Kirby Yates was the opener for the Pirates, giving up two hits and no runs in 1 2/3 innings. The right-hander had no walks and struck out one on 28 pitches. --Field Level Media

item.title: 中国、中東情勢巡り主権尊重主張 国連演説で暗に米国批判
item.description:
Antoni Slodkowski
［国連 ２６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Antoni Slodkowski

［国連　２６日　ロイター］ - 中国の韓正国家副主席は２６日、国連総会一般討論で演説し、湾岸諸国の主権を尊重すべきだと主張するとともに、「関係国」に対し、キューバへの威嚇をやめ、同国に対する封鎖を解除するよう求めた。

イラン戦争や米国によるキューバへの圧力を念頭にしたものだが、米国を名指ししなかった。

韓氏は「大国は国際平和と安全の維持に特別な責任を負うべきであり、規則の順守、法の支配の擁護、正しい行動に率先して取り組む必要がある」とし、「中国は、湾岸諸国を含む中東各国の主権と安全を尊重すべきだと考える」とした。

パデュー駐中国米大使は２５日、トランプ米大統領は２４日に行った中国の習近平国家主席との会談で、中国によるイラン支援は容認できないと明確に伝え、習主席は支援しないと確約したと述べた。

中国とイランを巡っては、中国が携行式防空ミサイル発射装置をイランに供給したとの報道や、中国の支援を受けてイランが石油販売石油販売に対する制裁を回避する手段を見いだしたといった報道が出ている。

＜キューバ封鎖解除要求＞

韓氏はキューバについて、「中国は関係国に対し、キューバへの武力行使の威嚇を直ちにやめ、キューバに対する封鎖と制裁を即時かつ全面的に解除するよう求める」と述べた。

キューバでは米国が１月に始めた石油封鎖により停電が深刻化している。

韓氏は演説で、中国は国際舞台で信頼できるパートナーであり、途上国の揺るぎない擁護者だとした。

「中国は、大小を問わず全ての国が国際社会の平等な一員であり、世界の問題は全ての国が協議を通じて扱うべきだと考える」と述べた。

item.title: Ronny Mauricio's 2 HRs help Mets take down Nats
item.description: Ronny Mauricio homered twice, A.J. Ewing hit a three-run home run and the New York Mets beat the host Nationals 7-1 on Saturday in Washington.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Ronny Mauricio homered twice, A.J. Ewing hit a three-run home run and the New York Mets beat the host Nationals 7-1 on Saturday in Washington. Carson Benge had three hits and scored twice for New York, which evened the three-game series. Jake Irvin had retired eight straight Mets entering the seventh. Benge led off with a single and, with two outs, Francisco Alvarez walked. Ewing hit an 0-2 pitch out to right-center and the Mets led 3-1. Mauricio followed with a solo shot to right. Benge doubled in the eighth and scored on a two-out grounder that shortstop Nasim Nunez misplayed for an error. In the ninth, Ewing walked and Mauricio hit his second homer of the game and third of the season to make it 7-1. Two batters later Juan Soto was hit by a pitch on the right hand and left the game. Dedniel Nunez (2-1) pitched a scoreless sixth with three strikeouts to earn the win. James Wood had two of Washington's three hits. Irvin (2-10) gave up five runs (four earned) on seven hits over five innings of relief. Mets rookie Jonah Tong gave up a run on three hits over five innings in his final start of the season. He struck out a career-high nine batters and walked one. Washington starter Connelly Early pitched three scoreless innings and allowed one hit in his Nationals debut. Early was obtained from the Boston Red Sox for Curtis Mead in July while on the injured list with elbow inflammation. In the Washington third, Nasim Nunez was hit by a pitch leading off and Wood singled. After both runners moved up on a wild pitch, Abimelec Ortiz hit a fly ball to right center. Right fielder Benge made an impressive diving catch, but Nunez came home after the catch and the Nationals led 1-0. Soto singled leading off the New York fourth, but Irvin picked him off. Bo Bichette and Benge singled, but Mark Vientos grounded out and Brett Baty struck out. --Field Level Media

item.title: China y EEUU acuerdan entablar diálogo sobre IA y reducir aranceles durante visita de Xi
item.description: Estados Unidos y China acordaron reducir los aranceles sobre productos por valor de 30.000 millones de dólares e iniciar un diálogo sobre inteligencia artificial, según anunciaron ambos países tras la visita del presidente Xi Jinping a Washington.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Estados Unidos y China acordaron reducir los aranceles sobre productos por valor de 30.000 millones de dólares e iniciar un diálogo sobre inteligencia artificial, según anunciaron ambos países tras la visita del presidente Xi Jinping a Washington. Las reducciones arancelarias se aplicarían a las exportaciones estadounidenses, como productos agrícolas, madera y cosméticos, así como a las importaciones de Estados Unidos, entre las que se incluyen pequeños electrodomésticos, juguetes y artículos de decoración, según un comunicado de la Casa Blanca publicado el viernes. "Ambos países alcanzaron un consenso sobre las recomendaciones para un trato arancelario más favorable para 30.000 millones de dólares en productos no sensibles en ambas direcciones", afirmó la Casa Blanca. La cumbre de tres días entre Xi y el presidente Donald Trump, que concluyó el viernes, se caracterizó por la diplomacia personal más que por grandes avances públicos. Xi ya aterrizó en Pekín, según informó el sábado la agencia estatal de noticias china Xinhua. Ambas partes también acordaron crear un consejo comercial y ampliar los resultados de las conversaciones anteriores celebradas en Kuala Lumpur, según informó el ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores chino. El acuerdo se produce tras la decisión de las dos mayores economías del mundo de prorrogar por dos meses una tregua comercial que debía expirar el 10 de noviembre, lo que permite disponer de más tiempo para trabajar en un acuerdo comercial potencialmente más amplio, según declaró el miércoles el secretario del Tesoro de Estados Unidos, Scott Bessent. "Esta visita histórica ha enriquecido la relación constructiva y estable entre China y EEUU, ha mantenido la estabilidad general de las relaciones bilaterales, ha abierto un nuevo capítulo en las relaciones entre ambos países y tendrá un impacto de gran alcance en la paz y el desarrollo mundiales", afirmó el ministro de Asuntos Exteriores chino, Wang Yi, en un comunicado. DIÁLOGO SOBRE LA IA En materia de inteligencia artificial, ambas partes acordaron mantener un diálogo sobre los riesgos y beneficios de esta tecnología —la próxima ronda de conversaciones está prevista para noviembre— y establecer un canal de comunicación para incidentes relacionados con la IA, según informaron el ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores chino y la Casa Blanca. La Casa Blanca señaló que los líderes habían acordado utilizar el término "superinteligencia" en lugar de "inteligencia artificial". En un comunicado aparte, el ministerio chino señaló que Pekín valoraba el uso de este nuevo término por parte de Washington. A medida que la tecnología de la IA sigue avanzando, ambas partes deberían intensificar los intercambios y trabajar para alcanzar un consenso en consonancia con los nuevos avances, señaló. Ambas partes también acordaron apoyarse mutuamente en la organización de la reunión de líderes de la Cooperación Económica Asia-Pacífico (APEC) y de la cumbre del Grupo de los 20, y ambos líderes tienen previsto asistir a los encuentros organizados por la otra parte. En materia de política exterior, los líderes coincidieron en que Irán debe cumplir su compromiso de no desarrollar armas nucleares y en que ningún país ni entidad debe imponer peajes de tránsito en las vías navegables internacionales, según afirmaron ambos países.

item.title: Una fuerte tormenta provoca cortes de luz y deja en tierra a aviones en todo el noreste de EE.UU.Una fuerte tormenta provoca cortes de luz y deja en tierra a aviones en todo el ...
item.description: Una fuerte tormenta del noreste ha dejado sin electricidad a miles de hogares y negocios en el noreste de EE.UU., ha provocado la suspensión de cientos de vuelos y ha llevado a los líderes estatales a ...
item.dc:creator: Brian K. Sullivan
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Una fuerte tormenta del noreste ha dejado sin electricidad a miles de hogares y negocios en el noreste de EE.UU., ha provocado la suspensión de cientos de vuelos y ha llevado a los líderes estatales a declarar el estado de emergencia. Se cancelaron, como medida de precaución, dos conciertos que la estrella del pop Ed Sheeran iba a dar este fin de semana en el Gillette Stadium, en las afueras de Boston. Los fuertes vientos azotaron la costa desde Delaware hasta Massachusetts el sábado, y se esperaba que las condiciones empeoraran en la ciudad de Nueva York a medida que avanzara el día, dijo Bob Oravec, pronosticador principal del Centro de Predicción Meteorológica de EE. UU. Se espera que las marejadas ciclónicas eleven el nivel del mar en tres pies a lo largo de la costa de Nueva Jersey y Nueva York, y aún más en toda Nueva Inglaterra. La luna llena del sábado por la noche empeorará la situación al elevar aún más las mareas. “Los peores efectos se sentirán esta noche y hasta la madrugada del domingo, desde el sur de Nueva Inglaterra hacia el oeste, pasando por Long Island hasta la Ciudad de Nueva York”, dijo Oravec. “Las inundaciones costeras serán el mayor impacto de esta tormenta”. La gobernadora de Nueva York, Kathy Hochul, declaró el viernes un estado de emergencia en la Ciudad de Nueva York y sus alrededores a medida que la tormenta se intensificaba, y la gobernadora de Nueva Jersey, Mikie Sherrill, hizo lo mismo en su estado. Desde Massachusetts hasta Maryland, 101.674 hogares y negocios se encontraban sin electricidad a la 1:15 p. m., siendo las zonas de Queens, Long Island y a lo largo de la costa de Nueva Jersey las más afectadas, según Poweroutage.com. Los árboles son especialmente vulnerables, ya que aún conservan sus hojas, lo que podría provocar la caída de ramas que derriben más líneas eléctricas. Mientras tanto, los trabajadores de la ciudad de Nueva York se preparaban para árboles arrancados de raíz y sumideros obstruidos ante la posibilidad de inundaciones, según indicó el alcalde Zohran Mamdani en un comunicado. El pronóstico de lluvia para la ciudad se duplicó a unas seis pulgadas el sábado, lo que provocó inundaciones costeras y dejó sin electricidad a unos 22.000 clientes, señaló Hochul en una conferencia de prensa el sábado por la mañana. “Esperamos que este patrón climático continúe e incluso se intensifique durante el próximo día”, dijo Hochul. “Esto podría, y de hecho ya lo ha hecho, derribar árboles y líneas eléctricas y provocar cortes de energía”. También se cancelaron el Global Citizen Festival en el Central Park de Nueva York y el festival de música y cultura All Things Go NYC. En Nueva Jersey, la tormenta inundó algunas carreteras costeras y de la bahía interior, dejándolas intransitables, y las autoridades instaron a los residentes a no circular por ellas. Sherrill señaló en una publicación en redes sociales el sábado que las condiciones habían mejorado temporalmente en algunas partes del estado, pero que se esperaba que empeoraran nuevamente más tarde ese mismo día. En todo Estados Unidos se cancelaron 425 vuelos, en su mayoría desde el Aeropuerto Internacional Logan de Boston y otros aeropuertos de Massachusetts, según informó FlightAware. También se cancelaron al menos 15 vuelos desde el Aeropuerto LaGuardia de Nueva York. Según indicó la Administración Federal de Aviación en su sitio web, era probable que se produjeran suspensiones de despegues y retrasos en Newark, Filadelfia, Washington y también en el Aeropuerto Internacional John F. Kennedy. New Jersey Transit suspendió su servicio de tren ligero River Line a lo largo del río Delaware, entre las estaciones de Florence y Cass Street, al sur de Trenton. El Long Island Rail Road suspendió el servicio en su ramal de Long Beach debido a las inundaciones del sábado. La Autoridad de Transporte de la Bahía de Massachusetts ha suspendido la mayoría de sus transbordadores de cercanías en el puerto de Boston y sus alrededores. El Servicio Meteorológico Nacional emitió alertas y avisos de inundaciones costeras, incluso para la ciudad de Nueva York, donde indicó que las mareas podrían alcanzar hasta tres pies más de lo normal en The Battery, en el extremo sur de Manhattan, y que olas de hasta 12 pies (3,6 metros) podrían romper contra la costa en Brooklyn y Queens hasta el domingo. Desde la costa de Nueva Inglaterra hasta la de Nueva Jersey, las ráfagas de viento podrían alcanzar las 60 millas (97 km) por hora. Oravec dijo que la tormenta seguirá siendo intensa en Nueva York y Nueva Inglaterra hasta el domingo, pero que se habrá debilitado para el lunes por la mañana, cuando los trabajadores deban regresar a la oficina. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Mbappé fue diagnosticado con una hiperextensión de rodilla, según el Real Madrid
item.description: El delantero francés Kylian Mbappé ha sufrido una hiperextensión en la rodilla izquierda, según informó el sábado su club, el Real Madrid.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El delantero francés Kylian Mbappé ha sufrido una hiperextensión en la rodilla izquierda, según informó el sábado su club, el Real Madrid. El capitán de la selección francesa ha abandonado el equipo nacional, tras verse obligado a abandonar el terreno de juego poco después de marcar el gol de la victoria en el partido de la Liga de Naciones del viernes, que Francia ganó por 1-0 a Turquía. El jugador, de 27 años, recibió asistencia médica tras el gol y volvió brevemente al terreno de juego, pero volvió a caer al suelo momentos después y no pudo continuar, lo que llevó al seleccionador francés, Zinedine Zidane, a sustituirlo en el minuto 58 de su primer partido al frente del equipo. "Tras las pruebas realizadas hoy a nuestro jugador Kylian Mbappé por los Servicios Médicos de Real Madrid se le ha diagnosticado una hiperextensión de la cápsula posterior de la rodilla izquierda", señaló el comunicado. "Pendiente de evolución", agregó La Federación Francesa de Fútbol había indicado inicialmente que Mbappé sufría una "lesión en un tendón de la rodilla" y que había regresado a Madrid para someterse a más pruebas. El Real Madrid recibirá al Villarreal en LaLiga el 10 de octubre.

item.title: Líbia reabre oleoduto Sharara-Zawiya após fechamento
item.description: A Corporação Nacional de Petróleo da Líbia informou neste sábado que reabriu a válvula nº 7 do principal oleoduto Sharara-Zawiya de petróleo bruto e retomou as operações de bombeamento.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Corporação Nacional de Petróleo da Líbia informou neste sábado que reabriu a válvula nº 7 do principal oleoduto Sharara-Zawiya de petróleo bruto e retomou as operações de bombeamento. O fluxo de petróleo bruto deve voltar gradualmente ao normal após o fechamento do oleoduto nesta semana.

item.title: Ucrânia intercepta 55% dos drones russos movidos a jato, diz Zelenskiy
item.description: As defesas aéreas ucranianas estão atualmente interceptando 55% dos drones a jato lançados pela Rússia, disse neste sábado o presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: As defesas aéreas ucranianas estão atualmente interceptando 55% dos drones a jato lançados pela Rússia, disse neste sábado o presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy. Ele fez essa observação em seu discurso noturno, enquanto os ataques com drones russos à capital, Kiev, e a outras cidades ucranianas continuam.

item.title: China e EUA concordam em dialogar sobre IA e reduzir tarifas sobre US$30 bilhões em mercadorias durante visita de Xi
item.description: Os Estados Unidos e a China concordaram em reduzir as tarifas sobre US$30 bilhões em mercadorias e iniciar um diálogo sobre inteligência artificial, informaram os dois países após a visita do presidente Xi Jinping a Washington.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os Estados Unidos e a China concordaram em reduzir as tarifas sobre US$30 bilhões em mercadorias e iniciar um diálogo sobre inteligência artificial, informaram os dois países após a visita do presidente Xi Jinping a Washington. As reduções tarifárias se devem aplicar a exportações dos EUA, como produtos agrícolas, madeira e cosméticos, assim como a importações dos EUA, incluindo pequenos eletrodomésticos, brinquedos e artigos de decoração, segundo comunicado divulgado pela Casa Branca na sexta-feira. “Os dois países chegaram a um consenso sobre recomendações para um tratamento tarifário mais favorável para US$30 bilhões em mercadorias não sensíveis em ambas as direções”, afirmou a Casa Branca. A cúpula de três dias entre Xi e o presidente Donald Trump, que terminou na sexta-feira, destacou a diplomacia pessoal em vez de grandes avanços públicos. Xi já pousou em Pequim, informou a agência de notícias estatal chinesa Xinhua neste sábado. Os dois lados também concordaram em criar um conselho comercial e ampliar os resultados das negociações anteriores em Kuala Lumpur, informou o Ministério das Relações Exteriores da China. O acordo segue iniciativa das duas maiores economias do mundo de prorrogar por dois meses uma trégua comercial que deveria expirar em 10 de novembro, dando mais tempo para a busca de um acordo comercial potencialmente maior, afirmou na quarta-feira o secretário do Tesouro dos EUA, Scott Bessent. “Esta visita histórica enriqueceu a relação construtiva e estável entre a China e os EUA, manteve a estabilidade geral dos laços bilaterais, abriu um novo capítulo nas relações entre os dois países e terá um impacto de longo alcance na paz e no desenvolvimento mundial”, afirmou o ministro das Relações Exteriores da China, Wang Yi, em comunicado. DIÁLOGO SOBRE IA Sobre inteligência artificial, os dois lados concordaram em manter um diálogo sobre os riscos e benefícios da tecnologia, com a próxima rodada de discussões marcada para novembro, e acertaram de estabelecer um canal de comunicação para incidentes relacionados à IA, informaram o Ministério das Relações Exteriores da China e a Casa Branca. A Casa Branca informou que os líderes concordaram em usar o termo “superinteligência” em vez de “inteligência artificial”. Em um comunicado separado, o ministério chinês afirmou que Pequim valorizou o uso do novo termo por parte de Washington. À medida que a tecnologia de IA continua a avançar, as duas partes devem intensificar intercâmbios e trabalhar em busca de um consenso, de acordo com os novos desdobramentos, afirmou. Os dois lados também concordaram em apoiar-se mutuamente na organização da reunião de líderes da Cooperação Econômica Ásia-Pacífico (Apec) e da cúpula do Grupo dos 20 (G-20). Em relação à política externa, os líderes concordaram que o Irã deve cumprir seu compromisso de não desenvolver armas nucleares e que nenhum país ou entidade deve impor taxas de trânsito em vias navegáveis internacionais, afirmaram os dois países.

item.title: Georgia replace manager Sagnol with Svanadze after Northern Ireland loss
item.description: Georgia have sacked manager Willy Sagnol in the wake of their Nations League defeat at home to Northern Ireland, and appointed Ramaz Svanadze as the new boss, the Georgian Football Federation said on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Georgia have sacked manager Willy Sagnol in the wake of their Nations League defeat at home to Northern Ireland, and appointed Ramaz Svanadze as the new boss, the Georgian Football Federation said on Saturday. Svanadze had been manager of Georgia's Under-21 side for the past five years, and has signed a contract until the end of 2028. Sagnol had been in charge since 2021 and the Frenchman guided Georgia to their first major tournament when they qualified for Euro 2024, where they lost to eventual winners Spain in the last 16, but results since then have failed to live up to those heights. In the most recent World Cup qualifying campaign, Georgia lost five of their six group games to miss out on the tournament, and Friday's 1-0 loss in Tbilisi was Sagnol's final act as national coach. "Thank you, Willy Sagnol, for every minute spent in the Georgian national team and for the emotions we went through together on this historic path," a Georgian FA statement said. Svanadze's first game in charge will be Monday's Group B2 game at home to Ukraine.

item.title: US to finalize sharply lower vehicle fuel economy standards
item.description: The US Transportation Department on Monday will finalize sharply lower vehicle fuel economy standards through 2031, reversing a push by the Biden administration to force automakers to build more electric vehicles, officials said on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The US Transportation Department on Monday will finalize sharply lower vehicle fuel economy standards through 2031, reversing a push by the Biden administration to force automakers to build more electric vehicles, officials said on Saturday. President Donald Trump said he had approved new fuel economy standards for cars and trucks, which he said will lower the price of new vehicles. "A major victory for America's auto workers is coming Monday," Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said. The new standards would cut the cost of new vehicles but increase fuel consumption and carbon dioxide emissions for decades, according to the department's own estimates. Trump's push comes as American drivers are grappling with sharply higher fuel prices since the start of the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran at the end of February. Under Democratic President Joe Biden, the government sought to push automakers to build more electric vehicles to meet rising fuel-efficiency standards. Biden increased required fuel efficiency for cars by 8% annually for model years 2024 and 2025, 10% for 2026 and 2% annually from 2027 to 2031. The Trump administration in December proposed retroactively revising down the 2022 model year fuel economy standard and then raising it between 0.25% and 0.5% annually through 2031. The Transportation Department proposed a fleetwide average of 34.5 miles per gallon (14.7 km per liter) by 2031, down from 50.4 miles per gallon (21.4 km per liter) under Biden. It estimated its proposal would cut average new vehicle costs by $930 each. But it would increase fuel consumption by around 100 billion gallons through 2050, fuel spending by $185 billion and carbon dioxide emissions by about 5%, the department said. Trump's move will make it easier for automakers to sell consumers less efficient vehicles. "Lowering standards will accelerate what (Trump) has already been doing: handing the clean tech future to China and forcing Americans to pay more at the pump," said Pete Buttigieg, who headed the Transportation Department under Biden. Biden focused on reducing US greenhouse gas emissions and fossil fuel use, accelerating a transition to clean energy and making the US. a global leader in clean-energy technology and manufacturing.

item.title: Libya reopens Sharara-Zawiya pipeline after closure
item.description: Libya's National Oil Corporation said on Saturday it had reopened valve No. 7 on the main Sharara-Zawiya crude pipeline and resumed pumping operations, with crude flows gradually returning to normal after the pipeline was closed earlier this week.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Libya's National Oil Corporation said on Saturday it had reopened valve No. 7 on the main Sharara-Zawiya crude pipeline and resumed pumping operations, with crude flows gradually returning to normal after the pipeline was closed earlier this week. An armed group and members of the Petroleum Facilities Guard closed the valve on September 21, sharply reducing output at Sharara, Libya's largest oilfield. The disruption was linked to demands by Guard personnel over their status and funding. The NOC said in a statement that technical and operational teams had begun the necessary measures to safely restart operations and restore crude supplies to the Zawiya refinery and export terminals, with flows gradually returning to normal. The NOC estimated the five-day shutdown caused the loss of 942,376 barrels of production, worth about $95 million, and forced the closure of one unit at the Zawiya refinery as crude supplies fell. Sharara can produce around 300,000-320,000 bpd and sends crude north to Zawiya, whose refinery has capacity of about 120,000 bpd and supplies Libya's domestic fuel market. Sharara has faced frequent disruptions in recent years due to protests, political disputes and technical issues. The UN mission had warned that a prolonged disruption could hurt oil revenues, increase fuel-import needs and threaten fuel and electricity supplies. It also warned that actions undermining oil infrastructure could potentially trigger sanctions under relevant UN resolutions.

item.title: Blue Jays' Max Scherzer to ponder decision on 2027 in offseason
item.description: Toronto Blue Jays right-hander Max Scherzer said Saturday that he plans to take some time to determine if he'd like to come back for a 20th major-league season in 2027.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Toronto Blue Jays right-hander Max Scherzer said Saturday that he plans to take some time to determine if he'd like to come back for a 20th major-league season in 2027. "I'm going to make this decision about playing next year later in the offseason," Scherzer said. "I've gone through ups and downs throughout the season, I get it, but I've gotten to the point where I'm pretty healthy. I've talked to everybody in my inner circle and we all kind of feel the same way. We don't need to make a decision today. Get to the offseason and see how things unfold." Scherzer, 42, is slated to start Sunday's season finale against the visiting Cincinnati Reds. "I just want to go out there and pitch (on Sunday), knowing that you never know, it could be my last," said Scherzer, who is 3-9 with a career-worst 6.14 ERA in 17 appearances (all starts) this season. "Just in case. We've been eyeing this on the calendar for a couple of weeks now, knowing I was going to make the start in Baltimore (on Wednesday), but the kids were in school so we weren't able to get them to Baltimore. We had circled this one, if we were out of it, to still pitch Sunday. It gives me a chance to pitch in front of my kids one more time, if it is (the end). If it's not, who knows?" A two-time World Series champion, three-time Cy Young Award winner and eight-time All-Star, Scherzer is 224-126 in 500 games (491 starts). He ranks ninth all-time in strikeouts (3,550). "I have no idea how I'm going to feel here in six months," Scherzer said. "For me, right now it's just about being healthy, pitching in this last game and having fun with it, then seeing what happens. I really don't have any expectations of what happens. Pitching is so much fun. You never know. Really, I have no idea." Scherzer has pitched with the Arizona Diamondbacks (2008-09), Detroit Tigers (2010-14), Washington Nationals (2015-21), Los Angeles Dodgers (2021), New York Mets (2022-23), Texas Rangers (2023-24) and Blue Jays. --Field Level Media

item.title: Mbappé é diagnosticado com hiperextensão no joelho, diz Real Madrid
item.description: O atacante francês Kylian Mbappé sofreu uma lesão por hiperextensão no joelho esquerdo, informou seu clube, o Real Madrid, neste sábado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O atacante francês Kylian Mbappé sofreu uma lesão por hiperextensão no joelho esquerdo, informou seu clube, o Real Madrid, neste sábado. O capitão da França deixou a seleção nacional, tendo sido forçado a sair de campo logo após marcar o gol da vitória na partida de sexta-feira, quando a França venceu a Turquia por 1 a 0 pela Liga das Nações. O jogador de 27 anos recebeu atendimento médico após o gol e voltou brevemente ao campo, mas caiu novamente momentos depois e não pôde continuar, o que levou o técnico da França, Zinedine Zidane, a substituí-lo aos 58 minutos de sua primeira partida no comando. “Após os exames realizados hoje em nosso jogador Kylian Mbappé pela equipe médica do Real Madrid, foi diagnosticada uma hiperextensão da cápsula posterior do joelho esquerdo”, dizia o comunicado. Inicialmente, a Federação Francesa de Futebol informou que Mbappé havia sofrido uma “lesão no tendão do joelho” e havia retornado a Madri para exames complementares. O Real recebe o Villarreal pela LaLiga no dia 10 de outubro.

item.title: Furacão Polo, de categoria 4, ameaça costa do México
item.description: O furacão Polo afastou-se da costa do Pacífico do México neste sábado, já rebaixado para a categoria 4, mas deve atingir a costa da Baixa Califórnia do Sul na segunda-feira, segundo os meteorologistas.
item.dc:creator: Leila Miller
item.content:encoded: O furacão Polo afastou-se da costa do Pacífico do México neste sábado, já rebaixado para a categoria 4, mas deve atingir a costa da Baixa Califórnia do Sul na segunda-feira, segundo os meteorologistas. Na tarde deste sábado, Polo estava a cerca de 531 km a sudoeste da cidade turística mexicana de Cabo San Lucas, com ventos máximos sustentados de 233 km/h, de acordo com o Centro Nacional de Furacões dos EUA (NHC, na sigla em inglês). A tempestade se deslocava para noroeste. A AccuWeather, empresa privada de previsão do tempo, informou que o Polo deve perder intensidade gradualmente e atingir a Baixa Califórnia como um furacão de categoria 2. Ele deve atingir a costa em uma área afastada de centros populacionais densos, mas com algumas cidades pequenas, como Las Barrancas, informou a empresa. Vinte e quatro horas após atingir a costa, o furacão deve atingir a costa pela segunda vez ao longo do noroeste do México continental, trazendo inundações repentinas potencialmente fatais para partes da Baixa Califórnia do Sul, Sinaloa, Sonora e Chihuahua, informou a AccuWeather. Chuvas intensas e ventos fortes do furacão ao longo da costa do Pacífico do México forçaram deslocamento de pessoas, fechamento de portos e cancelamento de aulas nesta semana. Na cidade turística de San José del Cabo, policiais restringiram o acesso a uma praia na sexta-feira, pois o furacão gerou ondas altas e condições perigosas para a prática de surfe. Condições de furacão são possíveis na tarde de segunda-feira, de Punta Eugenia a Santa Fé, na Baixa Califórnia, informou o NHC.

item.title: Vollering edges rival Niewiadoma-Phinney for road race world title
item.description: Dutch rider Demi Vollering held off a late challenge from Poland's Katarzyna Niewiadoma-Phinney to win her first road race world title on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Rory Carroll
item.content:encoded: Dutch rider Demi Vollering held off a late challenge from Poland's Katarzyna Niewiadoma-Phinney to win her first road race world title on Saturday. Vollering crossed the line with her arms outstretched after 4 hours, 45 minutes and 9 seconds of racing, with Niewiadoma-Phinney taking second and Italy's Elisa Longo Borghini third in the UCI Road World Championships. Switzerland's Marlen Reusser was fourth and France's Juliette Berthet fifth. Niewiadoma-Phinney had stayed on Vollering's wheel for much of the final lap, but appeared to suffer cramp after launching an early sprint on the uphill run-in to the finish. "I can't believe it," said Vollering, who won her second Tour de France Femmes title in August. "I truly believe that I have a dream in my heart for a reason, and I worked so hard towards this goal," she said. "It takes guts to believe in it with your whole heart and to gather a team around you with such strong girls, and they all sacrifice for you." An early crash involving about 15 riders disrupted the race and forced out several contenders, including defending champion and local favourite Magdeleine Vallieres, Mauritius' Kimberley Le Court and Spain's Paula Blasi. Sweden's Caroline Andersson was treated at the scene and placed in a neck brace. Vollering launched her first major attack with 38km remaining, but her lead evaporated over the final two laps in sweltering conditions as enthusiastic fans packed the course. "There were so many moments I thought I went too early," Vollering said. "I didn't dare to turn around and look back because I felt like they were almost on my wheel already." When the chasers regrouped, Vollering said she remained determined to attack again. "At one point they came back and I was like, 'Oh shit,' but it's still not over," she said. "I just dared, tried again and never gave up to the finish line."

item.title: Irish football divided again as Nations League showdowns with Israel loom
item.description: Born of a split in 1921 when the island was partitioned, the Football Association of Ireland has again found itself divided ahead of their two Nations League clashes with Israel, with the players disagreeing over whether to boycott the first game on Sunday and goalkeeper Gavin Bazunu withdrawing from the squad.
item.dc:creator: Philip O'connor
item.content:encoded: Born of a split in 1921 when the island was partitioned, the Football Association of Ireland has again found itself divided ahead of their two Nations League clashes with Israel, with the players disagreeing over whether to boycott the first game on Sunday and goalkeeper Gavin Bazunu withdrawing from the squad. After hours of fraught meetings among the players and occasionally involving coaches and officials, FAI chief executive officer David Courell told a press conference that had been delayed by several hours that a "significant majority" of the squad had agreed to play Sunday's game in Debrecen, Hungary, but it was far from a unanimous decision. The handful of Irish journalists present peppered Courell and head coach Heimir Hallgrimsson with questions, asking how it came to be that such heated discussions were still taking place a day before the game. “Obviously, this affects all of them - nobody is comfortable at the moment, but it’s about limiting the damage both personally and also for Irish football. We need to find some solution on it," Hallgrimsson told reporters. "There’s nothing that we can do, there’s no action that we can do that everybody will agree to, so we need to find the solution and that will limit the damage for us as a group, for Ireland as a nation and for the Association, the future of football in Ireland.” Ireland is one of Europe's most outspoken critics of Israel's war in Gaza , and Irish fans and politicians had called on the team to boycott the Nations League B, Group 3 games, but the nation's governing body said it would go ahead with the games. The decision to play is at odds with a motion passed by the FAI's members last November calling on [USN:L8N3WJ27T TEXT:"Israel to be banned"] from European competition due to a number of breaches of UEFA regulations. Sunday's clash in Hungary is Israel's home game in the Nations League group and no Irish fans will be present. Security concerns mean that the game which should have taken place in Dublin on October 4 has been moved to the Serbian town of Backa Topola, where it will be played behind closed doors. BOYCOTT CAMPAIGN Led by Irish fans and political and sporting figures, there has been a strong campaign to boycott the games and Saturday's announcement that the players had voted to play against Israel was met with an immediate backlash against the governing body. “There is widespread public revulsion in Ireland at the prospect of our national team lining up against an Israeli side as its government carries out a genocide in Gaza and facilitates ethnic cleansing in the West Bank," Social Democrats parliamentarian Daniel Ennis, a former League of Ireland footballer with Bohemian FC, Shelbourne FC and Bray Wanderers, said in a statement. “But it is not the players’ failure – it is a failure of the Irish Government, the FAI and UEFA to do the right thing." Israel has denied committing genocide and said on Saturday that [USN:L1N45I05A TEXT:"football and politics should be kept apart"]. The group Irish Sport for Palestine was scathing about the decision to play Sunday's game. "Today is a colossal failure by the FAI. They have further exposed their lack of leadership and total incompetency," the group said in a statement. At the press conference, Courell revealed that a number of protest measures would be taken, such as an absence of handshakes between the players and no exchange of the customary pennant before the game. He said the Irish players would wear black armbands in honour of all the victims of the conflict while donating their match fees to charity.

item.title: Exxon firma acuerdo para extraer petróleo y gas natural de yacimientos de shale en Azerbaiyán
item.description: ExxonMobil ha formado una empresa conjunta con la compañía petrolera estatal de Azerbaiyán, Socar, que le permitirá explorar y desarrollar “recursos de hidrocarburos no convencionales” en la cuenca de ...
item.dc:creator: Kevin Crowley
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. ( XOM ) acordó extraer petróleo y gas natural de los yacimientos de shale de Azerbaiyán, en el marco de la expansión internacional de la experiencia en fracturación hidráulica de este gigante energético de Texas. ExxonMobil ha formado una empresa conjunta con la compañía petrolera estatal de Azerbaiyán, Socar, que le permitirá explorar y desarrollar “recursos de hidrocarburos no convencionales” en la cuenca del Kura Medio, según informaron las empresas en un comunicado. ExxonMobil se encargará de operar el proyecto, una vez que cuente con la aprobación del poder legislativo del país. El shale estadounidense ha sido la mayor fuente de nuevos suministros mundiales de petróleo durante los últimos 15 años, lo que ha transformado al país en el mayor productor de crudo y exportador de gas natural licuado. ExxonMobil y otras empresas están interesadas en llevar las lecciones aprendidas en la cuenca del Pérmico y otros yacimientos de shale de EE.UU. a países con características geológicas similares. VER MÁS: Exxon negocia su regreso a Venezuela a medida que se aceleran los acuerdos con EE.UU. Las estructuras legales y regulatorias que rigen dicha perforación y producción de petróleo suelen ser más complicadas que en EE UU., lo que requiere extensas negociaciones antes de que comiencen las operaciones. ExxonMobil y SOCAR han estado en conversaciones durante más de un año sobre los aspectos comerciales y de otro tipo del acuerdo, que ha contado con el respaldo de la administración de Trump. “Combinaremos el conocimiento de SOCAR sobre Azerbaiyán con la experiencia y la tecnología global de ExxonMobil para comprender mejor el potencial de la cuenca y buscar oportunidades para un desarrollo seguro y eficiente”, dijo Bart Cahir, vicepresidente senior de ExxonMobil. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Boeing flags 737 MAX software glitch affecting landing navigation feature, WSJ reports
item.description: Boeing has identified a previously undisclosed 737 MAX software glitch that could cause an automated navigation feature to fail during landing, the Wall Street Journal reported on Saturday, citing company documents.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Boeing (BA.N) has identified a previously undisclosed 737 MAX software glitch that could cause an automated navigation feature to fail during landing, the Wall Street Journal reported on Saturday, citing company documents. The issue emerged from a cockpit software update and can occur when flight crews alter their planned flight path after a missed approach, the report said. When reached for comment, Boeing said it informed all 737 operators last month about the software issue under which pilots may not have access to automated flight guidance during a specific landing scenario. "We shared information with operators that reinforced existing pilot procedures for safely handling such cases. Our engineers are working on a software update to permanently address the issue," Boeing said in an emailed statement to Reuters. The Federal Aviation Administration said it was aware of a potential issue in a software update for the flight computers on certain Boeing 737 MAX airplanes and was working closely with Boeing and the airlines. "The FAA will convene a Corrective Action Review Board and will take immediate action if it identifies a safety concern," the FAA said in a statement. Boeing has been under intense regulatory and safety [USN:L1N4400RH TEXT:"scrutiny"] in recent years following two fatal 737 MAX crashes in 2018 and 2019 that led to a worldwide grounding of the aircraft, and after a mid-air cabin panel blowout on a nearly new Alaska Airlines (ALK.N) MAX 9. Southwest Airlines (LUV.N) and United Airlines (UAL.O) have asked Boeing not to deliver new 737 MAX aircraft equipped with the affected software and instead requested an earlier version, according to WSJ. It was not immediately clear how many aircraft are operating with the flawed software, the report said. Boeing, airlines and regulators are assessing the issue and whether it poses a flight-safety concern, it added.

item.title: Report: Packers to sign G Laken Tomlinson
item.description: The Green Bay Packers are signing guard Laken Tomlinson off the Dallas Cowboys' practice squad, NFL Network reported on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Green Bay Packers are signing guard Laken Tomlinson off the Dallas Cowboys' practice squad, NFL Network reported on Saturday. The report comes two days after the Packers' offensive line struggled to protect quarterback Jordan Love in Thursday's 35-14 loss to the Atlanta Falcons. Green Bay's ground attack mustered just 17 yards on nine carries. Green Bay is dealing with a season-ending torn patellar tendon injury to right tackle Zach Bako-Bewele. Tomlinson, a former first-round pick of the Detroit Lions, did not play for the Cowboys this season. He played in 10 games (seven starts) with the Houston Texans in 2025. Tomlinson, 34, made the Pro Bowl with the San Francisco 49ers in 2021 and has appeared in 173 games (162 starts) with the Lions, 49ers, New York Jets, Seattle Seahawks and Texans. --Field Level Media

item.title: Colts place WR Alec Pierce on IR, elevate WR Anthony Gould
item.description: The Indianapolis Colts placed Alec Pierce on injured reserve Saturday and elevated fellow wide receiver Anthony Gould from the practice squad.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Indianapolis Colts placed Alec Pierce on injured reserve Saturday and elevated fellow wide receiver Anthony Gould from the practice squad. Pierce will miss a minimum of four games after aggravating a heel injury during Sunday night's 33-30 overtime loss to the Kansas City Chiefs. He is not eligible to return until the Week 7 game at Minnesota on Oct. 25. Signed to a four-year, $114 million contract extension on March 9, Pierce had one reception for 11 yards on Sunday. He caught four passes for 61 yards in the Week 1 loss to the Baltimore Ravens. Pierce, 26, led the NFL in yards per reception in each of the past two seasons. He averaged 22.3 yards in 2024 and 21.3 last season when he had the first 1,000-yard season of his career. A second-round pick by Indianapolis in 2022, Pierce has 162 receptions for 3,006 yards and 17 touchdowns through 66 career games (56 starts). Gould, 25, was elevated for the Colts' loss to the Chiefs. He returned four kickoffs in that game. Indianapolis (0-2) also elevated wide receiver Nick Westbrook-Ikhine to the active roster from the practice squad for Sunday's game against the visiting Houston Texans (0-2). --Field Level Media

item.title: Hungría podría pedir a los más ricos que paguen más en un plan de impuestos sobre el patrimonio
item.description: El gobierno de Magyar se encuentra bajo presión para reducir el déficit presupuestario para 2030, de un posible 7,5% del PBI este año al 3% necesario para ingresar a la zona del euro ...
item.dc:creator: Thomas Escritt
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Las personas más ricas de Hungría podrían enfrentar un gravamen sobre sus activos superior al 1% que ya se ha planteado como parte de un impuesto sobre el patrimonio que el gobierno quiere poner en vigor para enero, afirmó el primer ministro Peter Magyar. El gobierno de Magyar se encuentra bajo presión para reducir el déficit presupuestario para 2030, de un posible 7,5 % del producto interno bruto este año al nivel del 3 % necesario para ingresar a la zona del euro, al tiempo que promete mantener muchas prestaciones sociales introducidas como medidas preelectorales por el gobierno anterior. El partido de Magyar ha anunciado planes para un impuesto del 1% sobre las fortunas superiores a mil millones de forints (3.1 millones de dólares), y es posible que los más ricos tengan que pagar más, dijo el primer ministro el sábado. “Es posible que, por encima de los 500 mil millones de forints, el impuesto a pagar no sea del 1%; podría ser mayor”, declaró Magyar en un mitin en la ciudad de Szolnok. Muy pocos de los 10 millones de habitantes de Hungría cuentan con una riqueza de esta magnitud. De quienes sí la tienen, se dice que algunos la obtuvieron gracias a su cercanía con el predecesor de Magyar, el ex primer ministro Viktor Orbán, a quien se acusó de enriquecer a sus socios durante sus 16 años en el poder —una acusación que él niega—. Blikk publicó lo que, según el diario, eran detalles del impuesto sobre el patrimonio previsto, el cual, según afirmó, se aplicaría a cuentas bancarias, valores, participaciones en empresas y bienes inmuebles tanto en Hungría como en el extranjero. Los ciudadanos extranjeros no pagarían impuestos sobre sus activos en el extranjero, informó el periódico. Los votantes que le dieron a Magyar una victoria electoral aplastante en abril se dejaron convencer, en parte, por su promesa de tomar medidas enérgicas contra la corrupción y recuperar el dinero público que había ido a parar a manos de personas con buenas conexiones políticas bajo el mandato de Orbán. Magyar destituyó a los nombrados por Orbán de los altos cargos de los tribunales y de la Fiscalía General. También creó una agencia con el mandato de procesar los robos y recuperar el dinero público sustraído. Desde entonces, los fiscales han presentado cargos contra dos exministros acusados de enriquecimiento ilícito y contra un empresario vinculado a la familia de Orbán. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: IMF plans more talks with Gabon in coming weeks
item.description: The International Monetary Fund will continue to hold technical discussions with Gabon on fiscal and public debt developments that could pave the way for a new programme, the Fund said on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The International Monetary Fund will continue to hold technical discussions with Gabon on fiscal and public debt developments that could pave the way for a new programme, the Fund said on Saturday. The oil-producing nation has stepped up engagement with the IMF and the World Bank as it seeks to tighten public finances and secure fresh funding for basic infrastructure. Gabon [USN:L6N3ZZ0YJ TEXT:"formally requested"] an IMF programme in March. A month later, it said it would conduct [USN:L1N41E045 TEXT:"an audit"] detailing years of public borrowing, which the IMF called an important step to underpin the design of the future programme. The government said earlier this month that [USN:L6N4570MY TEXT:"the audit found"] its total debt burden was lower than previously thought, improving Gabon's chances of securing the programme and the much-needed funding that comes with it. "Technical discussions on fiscal and public debt developments, along with the outlook, will continue in the coming weeks, with a view to paving the way for program discussions," the IMF said in a statement after its visit. "The mission also discussed the authorities' ambitious structural reform agenda to improve the management of public finances." According to the draft budget for 2027, Gabon's government [USN:L6N45D0JN TEXT:"expects to raise"] 1.144 trillion CFA francs ($2.00 billion) from international markets next year, with debt service and debt repayments rising sharply. ($1 = 572.7500 CFA francs)

item.title: Israel defende que futebol e política permaneçam separados após Irlanda votar a favor de partida
item.description: A Federação Israelense de Futebol afirmou que o futebol e a política devem permanecer separados, após os jogadores da Irlanda terem votado, neste sábado, a favor da realização de partida da Liga das Nações entre as duas seleções, marcada para domingo, na Hungria.
item.dc:creator: Krisztina Fenyo
item.content:encoded: A Federação Israelense de Futebol afirmou que o futebol e a política devem permanecer separados, após os jogadores da Irlanda terem votado, neste sábado, a favor da realização de partida da Liga das Nações entre as duas seleções, marcada para domingo, na Hungria. Os jogadores da Irlanda adiaram a coletiva de imprensa pré-jogo e o treino após um membro da equipe anunciar sua intenção de se retirar devido a seu desconforto em jogar contra Israel.
